show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/Qw2nPL
show.description: A self-made chairman returns to honor his village, only to discover his own factory has become a living hell for the very people who raised him. Disguising himself as a worker, he uncovers corruption, exploitation, and betrayal at every level. As truth burns through lies, the hidden chairman rises to deliver justice—turning victims into warriors and a broken system into his battlefield.
